scope: Bounded adequacy check of HighFluxSPL timestamp and pulse-calibration records. This is not an estimator comparison, a physical calibration certificate or an improvement claim.
prior_information: The 2021 paper and source describe a fixed target, separate low-flux reference and calibrated pulse. The 2026 paper already reports full-acquisition fitted proxy parameters and block-based results for acq14. Those published outcomes are known. No local event outcomes have been analyzed. Source code, archive directory and sizes have been inspected. The original source uses holdoff+2 ns; the newer reader uses holdoff alone. Both are checked descriptively without selecting a fitted dead time.

archive.index_provenance: Public data link in Goyal-STIR-Group/HighFluxSPL README at 1494365d05867fa6bff9b989dc4f0bd5817a0b4e; ZIP central directory inspected using HTTP ranges.

checks: Retrieve only the three named members with ZIP CRC and size checks; record SHA256, file metadata and exact request ranges. Keep data outside Git.

List MATLAB variable names, shapes and classes. Inspect scalar numeric acquisition metadata. For the pulse calibration, inspect variable availability, finite/nonnegative values and normalization summaries; do not assume a smoothed pulse contains raw counts or uncertainty.

Allow full-file frame extent and array-length inspection for record provenance. Restrict phase/gap/multiplicity outcomes to frame IDs in [0,1000000). Preserve original order and record any ordering failure rather than silently sort.

Verify finite timestamps, integral nonnegative frame IDs and phases in the declared repetition period. Independently compute consecutive gaps from frame differences plus phase differences and from absolute timestamps; require disagreement at most 1e-5 ns.

Report gap quantiles and counts below each declared holdoff offset, allowing four raw timestamp bins for rounding. These are hard-cutoff compatibility diagnostics, not a fitted dead time or probability calibration.
Check that the newer source's acq14 nominal holdoff exceeds its stated 80 ns electronics dead time, and identify which further observation/calibration evidence is still missing.
decision_gate: Select further inference work only if the record supports reconstructible exposure and meaningful independent calibration. Preserve existing model-based results and compare any future method against joint likelihood and robust one-step inference, including calibration sensitivity. Resampling a histogram or fitting a full-record proxy does not independently validate the physical target.
boundaries: No depth/flux fit, hypothesis test, policy optimization, performance comparison or response analysis outside the fixed development range. No raw-data redistribution, Lean/Lake invocation, hardware operation, author outreach or publication. The beam reserve is untouched.
